source: IPCC 2019 V4 Ch.11 — NH3-N (FracGASM) lost from manure applied to soils (default 0.21; range 0.0-0.31). FAOSTAT EMN 'applied to soils' (72381) is already net of housing+storage management losses, so this is the post-application field loss only.

NH3-N lost from grazing-deposited (PRP) urine/dung; 0.10, lower than the 0.21 for surface-applied manure. NOTE: IPCC 2019 V4 Ch.11 Table 11.3 uses a SINGLE FracGASM (0.21) for BOTH applied organic N and grazing/PRP; the lower grazing value here follows the empirical evidence for reduced volatilization from grazing (rapid urine infiltration, less exposed surface) in Bouwman et al. 2002 (Glob. Biogeochem. Cycles 16:1024, doi:10.1029/2000GB001389) and the EMEP/EEA 2023 Air Pollutant Emission Inventory Guidebook (3.B), which bracket the reported grazing range ~0.07-0.14. Applied to the EMN 'left on pasture' pool (72380) in the land/full views only.
